w: The special Kishore Day program in the evening saw a dramatic presentation on world problems by the kishores. A representative of WHO talked about the global problems of health and disease. A kishore representing UNICEF talked on the negligence of parents in rearing their children as the root cause of world problems. And the Green Peace Movement expressed its frustration with the environmental crisis. A scientist voiced his plans to set up a space colony to escape our problem-filled world. Finally, as the panacea of all ills, a representative of the BAPS explained the power of Satsang as the answer to all problems...
Mr. Terrell Slayton, Assistant Secretary of Georgia State, presented Swamishri with a citation of Georgia's Goodwill Ambassador and Honorary Citizen.
The kishores and kishoris honored Lord Harikrishna Maharaj.

The 5-day program on the Shikshapatri concluded this morning. The history and significance of Raksha Bandhan was narrated by Viveksagar Swami. Swamishri finally blessed the devotees and sanctified rakhis were distributed to everyone.
At 6.50 p.m., Swamishri arrived in Kanajari. After performing Thakorji's pujan and arti at the Swaminarayan mandir, he blessed the audience and departed for Nadiad .

At the instruction of Swamishri, a 10-minute prayer (dhun) for rain was introduced from today in his morning puja. The dhun was chanted by over a thousand devotees and sadhus. Swamishri also joined in chanting the Swaminarayan dhun after puja.

ds.t: He showed them a mantra for life
w: Thursday, 4 August 2005 (Ashadh vad 30, Samvat 2061), Bochasan

NSG commandos had come specially for darshan at Akshardham in Gandhinagar. They learnt that Pramukh Swami Maharaj was nearby, so they expressed a wish to have his darshan. Of the four commandos in all, two had served on duty in that very complex during the terrorist attack. Now Hitesh brought all these commandos. Major Deepakkumar Vashishth, Narendrasinh, Dinesh and the other commandos bowed to Swamishri. Blessing them, Swamishri said, "Blessings to all of you. You have come for darshan of a holy place, and you are fighting for the country. You fight against terrorism, so God will protect you. My blessings to all of you are that you are able to fulfil this responsibility to the country. You will have peace in your life too, and God will give peace to your families as well. Keep praying to God when you get up in the morning. The protector is also God. He alone also gives strength. We fight with the intelligence He has given. Whatever work we do, we do only by God's power. If you act with the feeling 'I am doing it', you will fail. If you remember God, your path will open up." Meeting them with love, Swamishri showed them a mantra for life.

ph: Swamishri graciously waving the BAPS flag

w: Swamishri initiated a youth, Jaydeep K. Pedhadiya, of Bhadra into the parshad -fold of renunciation. He was renamed Shankar Bhagat. Swamishri inaugurated an audio CD of his blessings called Amrut Vani 14.

A youth phoned from abroad. Speaking to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, he said, "I love a girl and want to marry her, but the girl's parents want to arrange her marriage elsewhere." Then, offering some knowledge, he said, "In a love marriage, one should not look much at caste, should one? Isn't that right? If we look at it from the point of view of spiritual knowledge, where is caste and where is community?"

Hearing this, Swamishri burst out laughing and said to him, "You are a great man of knowledge." Saying this, Swamishri joked with him and said, "If you are a man of knowledge, I am a man of knowledge too. So listen to what I say: if it happens happily and willingly, then do it. If the girl wishes, she will marry you; otherwise, do it by pleasing her parents."
The youth said, "Please explain to her (the girl's) parents!"
Swamishri said, "Look, we are sadhus. We cannot explain to them in this way. But give the girl the strength to explain to her parents herself."
The youth said, "But I love her, so after marrying her I will not make her unhappy, will I!"
Swamishri said, "You know that you love her, but have her parents come to love you? Think about that. What is your hurry? If the girl truly wishes it from her heart, she will explain to her parents."

While reading letters, Pramukh Swami Maharaj read a newspaper clipping. Jayantibhai of the village of Shiyada in Chikhli taluka, who lives in America, is a satsangi volunteer. When his father Maganbhai passed away to Akshardham at the age of 92, his funeral procession was taken out with a band, flags and torches, and with firecrackers being set off in front. They had turned death into a festival. The newspapers had taken note of this. Swamishri read the clippings and said, "That is quite something!"

Today Mahant Swami Maharaj recalled a dream he had had:

"Shastriji Maharaj appeared and performed arti to this picture (murti). Then he merged back into it. Then he appeared directly at the Bochasan mandir, where there was the atmosphere of a pratishtha ceremony, and he performed arti there. Bapa (Pramukh Swami Maharaj) was doing mujra (dancing in devotion)..."
Swamishri showed how Bapa was doing mujra, raising both hands and acting out playing the kartal (hand cymbals). This was the first time anyone had darshan of Swamishri doing mujra like this.
Guessing why Yogi Bapa had not appeared anywhere in this dream, Swamishri said lightly, "Yogi Bapa must have been in the youth assembly!" Everyone laughed.
Today Viveksagardas Swami phoned. He asked, "Swami! Do you want to give any message?"
"Divyabhav (seeing divinity)," Mahant Swami Maharaj said with a smile.
On behalf of all the devotees, Viveksagardas Swami prayed, "May everyone's circumstances become good."
"I pray every day," said Swamishri.
How much our Ishtadev and our gurus do for us without our asking and without our saying!!

ds.t: Firm love for the great sadhu
w: In today's assembly, a presentation began on Swami's talk: "If there is love and trust, and one behaves without deceit, one becomes brahmarup."
As part of the programme, the youths asked Mahant Swami Maharaj, "What will you give us as a gift?"
"Akshardham," Swamishri wrote on the iPad.
Another youth asked, "'We are yours and you are ours': (is this called) trust...?" Then Swamishri was requested, "Please write your definition of trust."
Swamishri wrote, "Firm love for the great sadhu."
Today, before eating, Mahant Swami Maharaj, concerned about the devotees, asked, "What arrangements are there for the devotees' meals? What are we feeding them?"

Because in Swamishri's mind was the thought that, to attend the evening assembly, these devotees would have left home at 2.00 or 2.30, and by the time they got home after the assembly, it would be late at night.
In every step of Swamishri, one hears the footsteps of his own guru.

As part of Pramukh Swami Maharaj’s Centenary Celebrations, BAPS Swaminarayan Sanskrit Mahavidyalaya, Sarangpur, organized an Akshar-Purushottam Siddhant Karika Mukhpath Mahotsav. Around 100 students studying in various courses at BAPS Swaminarayan Sanskrit Mahavidyalaya, as well as those affiliated to the Mahavidyalaya through online courses or external studies through Shree Somnath Sanskrit University, enthusiastically participated.

The Swaminarayan Siddhanta Karika is an extract from the Akshar-Purushottam Darshan, which reveals the teachings of Bhagwan Swaminarayan. The students worked hard to memorize its 565 Sanskrit verses (karikas). The Mahotsav began on the afternoon of 4 August in Nenpur, where they were assessed through written and oral examinations.
That evening the students presented a novel Sanskrit play called ‘Pavani’, similar to the famous Sanskrit play ‘Pala’ of East India.

That evening the students presented a novel Sanskrit play called ‘Pavani’, similar to the famous Sanskrit play ‘Pala’ of East India. On the morning of 5 August the students participated in samuh puja and chorus singing of the Karika and Satsang Diksha. Thereafter, the students received experienced guidance from Shrutiprakashdas Swami, Bhadreshdas Swami and Atmatruptdas Swami. Overall, 11 male students successfully memorized all 565 karikas and received the title of ‘Karikajayi’ and 12 female students received the corresponding title of ‘Karikajayini’.

In the afternoon, a special assembly was also held at BAPS Mandir, Ahmedabad, in the presence of Ishwarcharandas Swami, Vivekasagardas Swami and Atmaswarupdas Swami, in which students presented their mukhpath and received their awards.
A separate assembly was also held for the female students to present their efforts in memorizing the karikas and receive their awards.
